title: A Rivergate for the Monsoon
author: Wren Quintana
blurb: Petra Voss, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
